mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendships(id, user_id, friend_id, status, message) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{friendId}, #{status}, #{message})
mapper.update: UPDATE friendships SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS from_user_id, u.username AS from_username, u.avatar_url AS from_avatar_url, f.message, f.status, f.created_at FROM friendships f LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{friendId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END AS friend_id FROM friendships f WHERE f.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (f.user_id = #{userId} OR f.friend_id = #{userId})

SELECT CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END AS friend_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, f.status, r.id AS room_id, lm.content AS last_message_content, lm.created_at AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages msg WHERE msg.room_id = r.id AND msg.created_at > COALESCE(m.last_read_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00')) AS unread_count FROM friendships f JOIN users u ON u.id = (CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END) LEFT JOIN chat_rooms r ON r.type = 'DIRECT' AND r.id IN (SELECT room_id FROM chat_room_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND r.id IN (SELECT room_id FROM chat_room_members WHERE user_id = (CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END)) LEFT JOIN chat_messages lm ON lm.id = (SELECT id FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = r.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN chat_room_members m ON m.room_id = r.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} WHERE f.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (f.user_id = #{userId} OR f.friend_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY lm.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM friendships WHERE (user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}) OR (user_id = #{friendId} AND friend_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friendships WHERE (user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}) OR (user_id = #{friendId} AND friend_id = #{userId})
